faq.q: What is the origin of Nuria?
faq.a: Nuria is associated with Arabic. Nuria is Arabic نُورِيَة (Nūriyya) 'luminous, of light', from نُور (nūr) 'light'. The source gloss 'Light' is broadly consistent. Same name as nouria.
Yes — the underlying form نُورِيَة is Arabic.

faq.q: What does Nuria mean in Persian?

faq.q: What are the variants of Nuria?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Nuria, nuria. Script forms are نوریه, نوریہ, نُورِيَة, नूरिया.

faq.q: Is Nuria a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
